channel.title: Knowledge Recorder Updates
channel.description: Signed macOS updates for Knowledge Recorder.

item.description:
Bug-fix release for macOS and Windows.
## macOS
- **Back to the main window hides the mini-player:** the mini-player's window button now switches to the main window and hides the mini-player, so only one recorder is on screen. Show it again from the main window's corner button. - **Nemotron on long meetings:** the experimental speaker separation no longer stops after 15 minutes; its time limit now grows with the meeting length. - **Gemma 4 download:** "Gemma 4 E4B Instruct" downloads again (about 4.3 GB). Existing downloads keep working. - **Help:** updated mini-player guidance in German and English.
## Windows
- **Mode selection sticks:** a mode chosen on the recorder card or in the mini-player is now saved and used for processing instead of snapping back to "Meeting Notes". - **Long meetings summarize locally again:** local summaries of long recordings no longer abort with "llama_decode failed: 'NoKvSlot'". - **Nemotron on long meetings:** no 15-minute limit anymore; the helper uses all processor cores at reduced priority (about 1.7× faster measured). - **Gemma 4 download:** "Gemma 4 E4B Instruct" downloads again (about 4.3 GB). Existing downloads keep working. - **Mini-player:** the back-to-main-window button hides the mini-player, and showing/hiding it is no longer undone when another setting is saved. - **Help:** updated mini-player and Nemotron guidance in German and English.

# Knowledge Recorder 1.1.70 — macOS update
## macOS
- Fixes the floating widget's layout loop on macOS 27, which could crash the app after stopping a meeting and again on the next launch. - Keeps the edge-anchored collapsed strip and expanded card behavior. Recordings and preferences are retained; interrupted processing can resume after restart.
This hotfix contains a macOS installer only. The current Windows release remains 1.1.69.
## Deutsch
- Behebt eine Layout-Schleife des Widgets unter macOS 27, die nach dem Stoppen eines Meetings und beim erneuten Start zum Absturz führen konnte. - Die schmale Rand-Leiste bleibt erhalten. Aufnahmen und Einstellungen werden nicht zurückgesetzt; eine unterbrochene Verarbeitung kann nach dem Neustart fortgesetzt werden.

# Knowledge Recorder 1.1.69 — macOS & Windows
## macOS
- Optional **Nemotron 3 (experimental)** local speaker separation, with a checksum-verified model download and bundled native runtime. The existing engine remains the default. - Non-blocking introduction reminder after recording starts, with an option to dismiss permanently. - **Review names** in meeting notes: suggestions from German/English self-introductions, conflict warnings and repeatable corrections of transcript speaker labels. - Updated German and English help. Recording and regular transcription are preserved if speaker separation fails.
## Windows
- Matching Nemotron 3, introduction reminder and name-review workflow, with word-timed Whisper alignment and a signed portable runtime. - Nemotron runs on CPU and can be slower than real time. It remains opt-in and experimental. - Matching bilingual help, cancellation and failure handling.
## Important limits
Name suggestions require review; they are not verified identities. Summary text is not automatically rewritten. No persistent voice profiles are created. Nemotron supports up to eight voices. The existing microphone/system distinction remains: a shared room microphone is not a new multi-person room mode.
Verified on Mac Studio and Grey Iron with 226 macOS tests, 285 Windows Core tests, synthetic-audio inference/cancellation checks and Light/Dark UI screenshots. Real-meeting accuracy has not been established by these synthetic tests.
